response:
It is completely understandable that you feel scared right now. Witnessing someone you care about harm themselves during an argument is deeply distressing, and locking yourself in the room was a very smart and safe thing to do. Your physical and emotional safety must always come first. 

If you feel that you are in immediate danger or if the situation escalates, please do not hesitate to call emergency services right away. Even if he is only hurting himself, this kind of behavior can be unpredictable. You can also reach out to the National Domestic Violence Hotline at 1-800-799-SAFE (7233) or text "START" to 88788 for confidential support and guidance on how to navigate this safely. Please trust your instincts, stay in a secure space, and consider reaching out to a trusted friend or family member so someone else knows what is happening.
